text:
ana: Heads-up: multiple reports of SDK differences across runtimes (Node vs Edge) and CJS/TS consumers hitting types issues. Anyone seen this?
sam: Yep. Two problems: how we pick `fetch` (undici vs global) and ESM/CJS export shape + typings.
mike: Need a tiny repro - is it missing API or import error?
ana: User on Cloudflare Workers: `TypeError: fetch is not a function` because our dynamic undici import is getting hoisted by bundlers.
sam: Proposal: prefer `globalThis.fetch` when present; fallback to dynamic `import('undici')` only when running in Node; make undici an optional peer dep; ship a tiny runtime helper to avoid bundler hoisting.
julie: Also saw auth header lost on 302 under undici - retry/redirect logic needs tests and possibly `redirect: 'manual'` plus safe re-insert logic.
mike: TS: ship `.d.ts`, set `types` in package.json and ensure exports map covers CJS/ESM; add README snippet for `require` vs `import`.
sam: Action items: sam -> runtime helper PR; ana -> exports/types doc; julie -> Workers CI job; mike -> retry/redirect tests.
ci-bot: branch `sdk/edge-fetch-fallback` created, CI scheduled.
